mapper.sql: id, violation_id, user_id, reason, status, reviewer_id, review_comment, submitted_at, reviewed_at, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appeal (violation_id, user_id, reason, status, reviewer_id, review_comment, submitted_at, reviewed_at, version) VALUES (#{violationId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewComment}, #{submittedAt}, #{reviewedAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE appeal SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
